versions.changelog:
Battery Bank Travel Allocator 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Estimate realistic power-bank delivery after voltage conversion, heat, age, and cycle losses.
- Budget device use based on screen time, activity, and starting charge.
- Compare demand with available power and get packing guidance for over- or under-provisioning.
- Check solar-panel yield and account for charge ceilings and common battery-planning pitfalls.
